chapters.title: Unit 1. My summer favourites

problems.condition: Unit 1 My summer favourites, с. 5. Прочитай вступительный текст — рассказ Лизы о себе.
steps: Hello! My name is Elizabeth (Liza) Bissett. I'm nine, but in November I'll be ten. I live with my mum and dad in London. I've got a cat, Tiggy. He is three. I like cooking and travelling.
problems.answer: Лиза Биссетт, 9 лет, живёт в Лондоне с родителями, у неё кот Тигги; любит готовить и путешествовать.

steps: 1) The letters are about summer holidays.
2) Liza likes summer because she travels with her family a lot. 3) Layla doesn't like summer because she has nothing to do.
4) When I travel I visit new places, eat nice dishes and bring gifts. When I stay at home I look after my pet and play computer games.
5) different, travel, stay, enjoy, going shopping, bring.
problems.answer: 1) о летних каникулах; 2) Liza — travels; 3) Layla — nothing to do; 5) different, travel, stay, enjoy, going shopping, bring

problems.answer: Ann — Lake Seliger; Bill — Disney World; Sid — Legoland; they like the rides
